No real person's mail is in it; company names make sender shapes realistic and none of these messages was sent by those companies. Every label was written and committed before any WO-045 classifier change. Splits: 'dev5' (read for misses) and 'dev5check' (FNV-1a of id + 'wo-045-seed-20261020', mod 4 == 0; never read item by item before its one-time score).
